notes.title: Update 1.0.2 is Here – Quality of Life & Fixes Update!
notes.content: [h1]Hey everyone![/h1][hr][/hr][p]This update is all about smoothing out your gameplay experience and fixing some long-standing bugs. Here’s what’s new and improved:[/p][h3] [b]Input & Control Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]controller input would break keyboard & mouse controls[/b]. You can now swap between them without problems.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]mouse no longer snaps to the centre of the screen[/b] randomly when in use.[/p][/*][/list][h3] [b]Night Mode Overhaul[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Night mode is actually dark now.[/b] It's spooky, it’s tense — just the way it should be. Bring a flashlight… or don’t. 👀[/p][/*][/list][h3] [b]Saving & Loading Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Settings now save and load correctly[/b] when restarting the game — no more redoing your setup every time![/p][/*][*][p][b]Last map played is remembered and reloads properly[/b] when you start the game again.[/p][/*][/list][h3] [b]Gameplay Tweaks[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Spinning blade traps now scale damage with the player[/b], instead of doing a flat 25 damage. Much more balanced.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Resolution scaling has been fixed![/b] Certain resolutions that were previously broken now work, including [b]Steam Deck resolution[/b]. (Hint hint.)[/p][/*][/list][h3] [b]Settings Menu Upgrade[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added a [b]visual aid for controller mapping[/b] in the settings! Now you can clearly see what each button does at a glance.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]A Quick Note from Me[/b][/p][p]I’m working on a [b]content update[/b] that will bring [b]new shop options[/b] (hint: customization), as well as some fresh [b]map[/b] and [b]zombie[/b] content.[/p][p]Also slowly chipping away at something [b]multiplayer-related[/b]… but more on that later. 👀[/p][p]Stay tuned on my socials for sneak peeks and dev updates![/p][p]— Filip[/p]

tags.bug: Fixed an issue where [b]controller input would break keyboard & mouse controls[/b]. You can now swap between them without problems.
The [b]mouse no longer snaps to the centre of the screen[/b] randomly when in use.
[b]Night mode is actually dark now.[/b] It's spooky, it’s tense — just the way it should be. Bring a flashlight… or don’t. 👀
[b]Settings now save and load correctly[/b] when restarting the game — no more redoing your setup every time!
[b]Last map played is remembered and reloads properly[/b] when you start the game again.

tags.balance_change: [b]Spinning blade traps now scale damage with the player[/b], instead of doing a flat 25 damage. Much more balanced.

tags.bug: [b]Resolution scaling has been fixed![/b] Certain resolutions that were previously broken now work, including [b]Steam Deck resolution[/b]. (Hint hint.)

tags.feature: Added a [b]visual aid for controller mapping[/b] in the settings! Now you can clearly see what each button does at a glance.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1 is Here – Controller Support, Fixes, and More!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey everyone![/h3][p]This long-awaited update is finally live! Thank you all so much for your patience and support — I know it's been a bit quiet, but I’ve been hard at work behind the scenes to bring you improvements and prepare for bigger things to come. Here’s what’s new in this patch:
[/p][h3][b]Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Menu buttons now behave like classic UI — press-to-click works correctly with a mouse.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed an issue where [b]health drops[/b] weren’t spawning properly.[/p][/*][*][p] The [b]Discord community[/b] is now more visible — come join the discussions, leave feedback, or just hang out![/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3] [b]New Additions[/b][/h3][list][*][p] [b]Full Controller Support![/b]
You can now navigate menus and play entirely with a controller — perfect for couch gamers or those who prefer it that way.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3] [b]Coming Soon[/b][/h3][p]I'm currently working on some exciting new content and quality-of-life features, including:[/p][list][*][p] [b]An “Auto Kill” option[/b] to speed up gameplay and test builds.[/p][/*][*][p]More upgrade types and weapon variety.[/p][/*][*][p]More bug fixes and polish across systems.[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced enemy behaviors and more surprises.[/p][p]
[b]A Quick Note from Me[/b][/p][p]I'm a solo developer juggling everything from code to UI to design, and I want to thank you all for your patience as updates take time. I genuinely appreciate the support, feedback, and encouragement. Your input shapes this game — and more updates are coming your way soon![/p][p]Stay tuned, and if you haven't already, hop into the Discord to be part of the community.
Thanks again and happy surviving![/p][p]— Filip


[/p][/*][/list]

tags.bug: Menu buttons now behave like classic UI — press-to-click works correctly with a mouse.
Fixed an issue where [b]health drops[/b] weren’t spawning properly.

tags.feature: The [b]Discord community[/b] is now more visible — come join the discussions, leave feedback, or just hang out!

[b]Full Controller Support![/b]
You can now navigate menus and play entirely with a controller — perfect for couch gamers or those who prefer it that way.
